sources.institution: Hastie, T., Tibshirani, R., & Wainwright, M. (2015). Statistical Learning with Sparsity: The Lasso and Generalizations
sources.role: Authoritative treatise on high-dimensional regression, Lasso, Elastic Net, coordinate descent, and asymptotic sparsity bounds

sources.institution: Mahoney, M.W. (2011). Randomized Algorithms for Matrices and Data
sources.role: Foundational review of Randomized Numerical Linear Algebra (RandNLA), matrix sketching, and leverage score sampling

sources.institution: Efron, B. (2012). Large-Scale Inference: Empirical Bayes Methods for Estimation, Testing, and Prediction
sources.role: Seminal monograph on False Discovery Rate (FDR), local false discovery rate, and empirical Bayes multiple testing

sources.institution: Leskovec, J., Rajaraman, A., & Ullman, J.D. (2020). Mining of Massive Datasets (3rd ed.)
sources.role: Comprehensive manual on MapReduce algorithms, data stream sketching, Count-Min sketch, and HyperLogLog
